name: seis-goal-integrity
description: Read-only validation of SEIS goal IDs, statuses, evidence hints, and single-goal bindings.

interface.shortDescription: Check goal identity and status truthfulness locally.
interface.longDescription: A deterministic, local-only SEIS governance plugin that checks goal records for stable IDs, valid lifecycle states, duplicate records, blocked-state explanations, and the SEIS-GOAL-021 single-goal binding without writing files.
defaultPrompt: Validate the active SEIS goals safely.
Check this goal set for duplicate IDs.
Audit SEIS-GOAL-021 binding and status claims.
